title: Build Customer UGC Lookbook, Accessible FAQ Accordion, Footer and E2E Smoke Test
description: Implement the customer home interior lookbook with interactive 'Shop This Look' pins, shadcn accessible FAQ accordion, luxury archival footer, and complete Playwright end-to-end verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer Lookbook displays real interior photos with clickable hotspots linking to specific frames
FAQ Accordion is built using accessible Radix UI primitives with smooth height animation
Archival Footer provides brand story, newsletter signup, trust badges, and comprehensive links
Home page compiles with zero TypeScript errors and passes full Playwright visual smoke suite

steps.details: Create components/home/customer-lookbook.tsx with interactive frame tag popovers.
Create components/home/faq-section.tsx answering key framing and shipping questions.
Create components/layout/site-footer.tsx with newsletter capture and guarantee seals.
Compose all sections cleanly into app/page.tsx.
Run tsc, eslint, and Playwright test capturing full-page screenshot into .agent/screenshots/.
